title: Greatest Villager Spawn Egg Recipe
description: This project adds a very tedious villager spawn egg recipe. I thought it would be funny.
body:
It adds an incredibly tedious crafting recipe for villager spawn eggs.

Truthfully I made this mod just so I don't have to haul a bunch of villagers into my skybase on a minecraft server I'm in ran by my friends, but I've decided to publish it just incase SOMEONE wants to mess around with it, especially if they have a similar experience as me.

I intentionally made it incredibly tedious so I could convince my friend, the server's owner to actually add it. You must craft multiple items to even get a chance to craft the spawn egg, with all items costing dearly.

Anyways, have fun with my horrible mod I put barely any effort into. It took 2 long hours off my life.

This mod was made with MCreator: https://mcreator.net
